turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My nephew turns ten next week and loves board games.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice. Would he like something competitive where he can beat the grown-ups, or a cooperative game where everyone plays together?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me talk to Ryan for a bit, so please stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ryan, what's that thing you ordered last time? The cold one?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Cold brew with oat milk. It's really smooth.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it strong? I don't want to be awake all night.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Pretty strong. Maybe get a small one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I'll just have a tea and steal a sip of yours.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: One sip. I know what you're like.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again. What were we talking about?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. You were picking a game for your nephew, competitive or cooperative.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Competitive, for sure. He loves winning.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then Ticket to Ride is a great pick. It's easy to learn and kids beat adults all the time.
